cards.text: Haggai, a prophet, has been bringing the LORD's word to Judah while Zerubbabel the governor and the people rebuild the LORD's house (Hag 1:1, 1:14). On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the LORD already gave Haggai one message (Hag 2:10). Now the word of the LORD comes to Haggai again, and friend, back in the junk drawer the only messages I ever got were takeout menus.

cards.question: Haggai got a message from the LORD on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month. This new word of the LORD comes to Haggai on that same twenty-fourth day.

cards.text: This one's for Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, and Haggai's the delivery guy. Friend, this package is HEAVY, way bigger than one city or one building project.

cards.question: In His message for Zerubbabel, what does the LORD say He's about to shake?

cards.text: Then the LORD gets specific about the nations, starting at the very top with their royal thrones. The only throne I've ever had is this gold base, and it doesn't even come with armrests.

cards.question: In His message for Zerubbabel, the LORD says He will protect the royal thrones of the nations.
The LORD says He'll overturn the royal thrones of the nations, the seats kings rule from. What else does He say He'll destroy among the nations?

cards.text: Then the LORD turns to the battlefield, where He overturns chariots and their riders, and horses and their riders fall, "each by the sword of his brother." Flipped like cookies off a spatula, and THOSE never land pretty.

cards.question: The LORD says the horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother. What does that picture show?

answers.text: They drop their swords and run

cards.text: Thrones flipping, chariots flipping, and then the LORD calls one man by name, his father's name too. "On that day," He says, He will take Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel.

cards.question: Haggai is the prophet, and Joshua is the high priest (Hag 1:1). The LORD gives Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, another title. He calls Zerubbabel His ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD gives Zerubbabel a picture, and friend, this one hits close to home. It's something a king pressed down to seal with, the same job I do, so we're basically cousins (Est 8:8).

cards.question: On that day, what does the LORD say He will make His servant Zerubbabel like?
The LORD tells Zerubbabel why He'll make him like His signet ring. It's because the LORD has ___ him.
